title: Glean connector in Lakeflow Connect (Beta)
body:
You can now ingest data from Glean into Databricks using the managed Glean connector in Lakeflow Connect. The connector ingests company-wide usage insights for search, Assistant, and agents, along with the shortcuts (go links) defined in your Glean deployment, using a Glean Client API token. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types).

See [Glean connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/glean).
